patterns.message: lib/market-intel/core is the pure layer - no database, no framework, no other market-intel module. That is what makes it trivially unit-testable, and it erodes one convenient import at a time, so it is enforced rather than left to reviewer memory. Anything needing a database belongs in market/ or seller/. See docs/architecture.md.

Read modules must not import a cron job. Jobs run with the service-role key and bypass RLS by design; a request-scoped module importing one is how that privilege escapes the boundary it was meant to stay inside. Only /api/cron/* route handlers should call them. See docs/architecture.md.
